verdict.rationale: Token2's fido2-manage tool and Companion App let users delete resident credentials/passkeys, delete or rename biometric templates, and perform factory resets, giving concrete control over data deletion stored on the security key. However, there's no documentation addressing 'retention' policies (e.g., automatic expiry, data lifecycle controls) or deletion of any cloud-side data (e.g., Entra ID enrollment records), only local on-device deletion. missing for 10: explicit retention-period controls, deletion of any server/cloud-stored data, independent corroboration beyond vendor docs/GitHub.
